text:
deploybot: RELEASE CHECK: blocked deploy 2026-06-03T15:00Z -> prod. Reason: secret structure mismatch detected between staging and prod for service=inference-cache (key=credentials).
alex: ugh, I saw a lint warning earlier but thought it was staging-only. what exactly mismatched?
mira: deploybot attached diff: staging stores credentials as compact JSON string (escaped), prod expects nested map with top-level 'access'/'secret'.
sam: can you paste the diff?
mira: sure:
```
- staging: \"{\"token\":\"abc...\",\"url\":\"https://s3...\"}\"
+ prod: access:
+   token: abc...
+   url: https://s3...
```
jen: oh that explains the runtime crash in canary yesterday. the service tries to parse as map and gets a string.
alex: deploybot flagged it during preflight schema-check (new check we merged yesterday). good catch.
ops-bot: deploy policy: block-on-secret-schema-drift is ON for prod. Manual unblock allowed with approval and migration plan.
mira: options: 1) backfill prod secrets to compact JSON string (quick but fragile), 2) migrate services to accept both formats (code change + canary), 3) normalize at secrets-manager layer with a transformation job.
sam: prefer 3 long-term. short-term we need this release. change window ends in 2h.
jen: what's in the release? user-visible latency improvements + a model-variant pin. we could delay, but customers will notice.
alex: can we pin the release to dedicated pool and avoid touching inference-cache until next deploy? i.e., split the rollout.
mira: yes if we split the helm chart into two separate deploy jobs. but that adds complexity to release notes and might affect rollback boundaries.
ops-bot: recommended: hold prod rollout for inference-cache, continue with non-cache changes on canary only. Must document manual step for operators.
sam: i'm fine with splitting. who will do the normalization quick fix?
jen: I can write a tiny secret-transform script to convert nested map -> compact JSON and run as a one-off against prod secrets manager. low risk if we keep a backup.
alex: make sure to tag the kube secret with a migration-annot: `redwood.com/migrated=2026-06-03`. adds auditability.
mira: agree. also add a smoke check after backfill: deploybot can rerun schema-check and a small e2e that hits inference-cache.
jen: plan: 1) run `scripts/secret_migrate.py --service inference-cache --dry-run` now; 2) push real migration with backup; 3) re-run preflight; 4) proceed with prod rollout for inference-cache.
sam: timeline?
jen: dry-run in 10m (will take ~2m), real run after approvals (~15m), preflight ~5m, then unblock. still inside change window.
ops-bot: approval: @alex @mira please ack to proceed with migration.
alex: ack.
mira: ack. go for it.
jen: running dry-run:
```
$ python scripts/secret_migrate.py --service inference-cache --dry-run
DRYRUN: 3 secrets would be converted, no changes applied.
```
jen: doing backup and applying now. dropping a temp note in runbook.
jen: applied migration and added annotation to secrets.
jen: re-running deploybot preflight check...
deploybot: PRECHECK: success. secret-schema now matches expected nested map. all checks green.
mira: rolling prod inference-cache canary with image=redwood/inference:2026-06-03-rc1 (pin=sha256:abcd).
sam: start canary at 20% traffic. monitor latency and 5xx for 15m.
jen: release notes snippet for ops: "Hotfix: normalize inference-cache secret structure in prod to match runtime schema. Annotated secrets with redwood.com/migrated. If you need to rollback, restore secret backup from SSM path /backups/inference-cache/2026-06-03"
alex: also add CHANGES.md entry and update the deploy checklist.
ops-bot: deploybot: proceeding with canary. will auto-promote if no regressions.
deploybot: CANARY STARTED: job=deploy-inference-cache-canary id=dep-1758494021-1
sam: monitoring looks clean so far (no 5xx, latency steady).
mira: +1 after 20m. promote to 50% then full.
alex: after full promote, mark release as shipped and attach migration note in release notes.
jen: promoted to 50% -> 100%. all good.
ops-bot: UNBLOCK: deploybot removed block. prod rollout completed for inference-cache.
jen: pushing final release notes and tagging release v2026.06.03-hotfix-cache-migrate.
alex: kudos team. let's add a small test to CI to detect embedded-json-string secrets upstream so we avoid this next time.
mira: I'll open the PR. low friction changeset.
sam: and add an automated runbook step for secret migration in the runbook repo.
jen: done. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/412 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2875
alex: closing thread. thanks everyone :tada:
